title: Sheaf cohomology agrees with hypercovering Cech cohomology
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove the functors F |-> H^i(X,F) and F |-> Cech-HC^i(X,F) are canonically isomorphic, using the spectral sequence of lemma-cech-spectral-sequence: for surjectivity of H^p -> Cech, kill obstructions inductively - start with a hypercovering K on which xi restricts to zero at level 0 (example-cech plus kill-cohomology-class-on-covering), read the obstructions xi_q in Cech^{p-q}(K, underline H^q(F)) off the spectral sequence, and refine step by step: represent xi_q by a tuple over K_{p-q}, choose site coverings {U_{i,j} -> U_i} killing each component xi_{q,i}, form Z = {U_{i,j} -> X} -> K_{p-q} (a covering by definition-covering-SR), lift it to a morphism of hypercoverings L -> K with L_{p-q} -> K_{p-q} factoring through Z via lemma-covering, and use functoriality of the spectral sequence to zero out xi_q,...,xi_{p-1}; for injectivity, express a Cech class xi with zero image in H^p through the differentials d xi_q of the spectral sequence, kill the xi_q by the same refinement mechanism, and conclude xi restricts to zero on L.
